title: Patient-partnered research Patients partner with our scientists to accelerate the pace of discovery and find better treatments.
content: Patient-partnered research Patients partner with our scientists to accelerate the pace of discovery and find better treatments. By sharing their data, samples, and experiences, patients have the power to accelerate discoveries that could reveal new treatments for disease and improve health care. Our scientists partner with patients and their loved ones to guide research and ensure that all patients' voices are heard.
